bullets.text: Engineered a Python and Machine Learning production service that drafts three reply options for every customer review, using sentiment-conditioned prompts and per-dealership rules; the dealer selects and publishes one. Roughly 93% of drafts are published unedited, processing over 100k reviews a month.

Applied MLOps techniques to fine-tune Llama 3 using LoRA/QLoRA with Unsloth, yielding an 8B model distilled from 70B to follow strict client wording rules while preserving fast inference speed and low operational costs.

Deployed Docker containers on AWS EC2, configuring NVIDIA drivers and Linux from scratch, then led migration to an on-prem GPU server and implemented database caching for repeat requests to reduce operational costs and response times.
